authored_by: build owner, by hand-written reference SQL executed on the semantic layer; structured questions only

questions.question: How many ED visits were there in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: How many inpatient admissions were there in 2028?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='inpatient' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2028'

questions.question: Show monthly ED visits in 2029
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(event_date,1,7), COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: List inpatient stays admitted in 2029 by organization
questions.reference_sql: SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*), SUM(discharge_known), COUNT(*)-SUM(discharge_known) FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND substr(admit_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: What was the 30-day readmission rate in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(readmitted_30d), ROUND(1.0*SUM(readmitted_30d)/COUNT(*),4) FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND discharge_known=1 AND substr(discharge_date,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: Show appointments scheduled in 2029 by final status
questions.reference_sql: SELECT final_status, COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE substr(scheduled_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many patients have heart failure?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure'

questions.question: What are the 5 most common conditions?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

questions.question: Show medication fills in 2029 by drug class
questions.reference_sql: SELECT drug_class, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM fill WHERE substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029' AND drug_class IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many statin fills were there in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: How many members did each payer have in 2029-06?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM member_month WHERE month='2029-06' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many patients are there by sex?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sex_reported, COUNT(*) FROM patient GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Count of emergency department visits during 2028
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2028'

questions.question: Give me the number of hospital admissions in 2029
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='inpatient' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: Month-by-month counts of inpatient admissions for 2029
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(event_date,1,7), COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='inpatient' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Break down the appointments scheduled in 2028 by their final status
questions.reference_sql: SELECT final_status, COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE substr(scheduled_date,1,4)='2028' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many people have diabetes on record?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='diabetes'

questions.question: Top 10 conditions ranked by number of patients
questions.reference_sql: SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 10

questions.question: Number of metformin fills in 2028 and how many patients had them
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM fill WHERE drug_class='metformin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2028'

questions.question: For services in 2028, give claims and billed, allowed and paid amounts for each payer
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payer, COUNT(*), SUM(billed_cents), SUM(allowed_cents), SUM(net_payer_paid_cents) FROM claim WHERE substr(service_date,1,4)='2028' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Per-payer share of claims that were ever denied, for services in 2029
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payer, COUNT(*), SUM(ever_denied), ROUND(1.0*SUM(ever_denied)/COUNT(*),4) FROM claim WHERE substr(service_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Enrolled members per payer for the month 2029-03
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM member_month WHERE month='2029-03' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Deaths recorded during 2028
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM death WHERE substr(death_date,1,4)='2028'

questions.question: Patient counts split by coverage type
questions.reference_sql: SELECT coverage_type, COUNT(*) FROM patient GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many appointments scheduled in 2029 had a final status of no_show?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE substr(scheduled_date,1,4)='2029' AND final_status='no_show'

questions.question: How many patients have condition evidence of both hypertension and diabetes?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept IN ('hypertension','diabetes') GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT concept)=2)

questions.question: How many distinct patients had at least 3 inpatient utilization events in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT patient_id FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='inpatient' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>=3)

questions.question: Which month of 2029 had the most ED visits, and how many were there?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(event_date,1,7), COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many immunization records have an event date in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunization WHERE substr(event_date,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: How many patients had a statin fill in 2029 but no statin fill in 2028?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2028')

questions.question: How many claims for services in 2029 have a final status of paid?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim WHERE substr(service_date,1,4)='2029' AND final_status='paid'

questions.question: How many enrolled member-month rows are there for months in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_month WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2029'

questions.question: Show recorded deaths in 2029 by death source
questions.reference_sql: SELECT death_source, COUNT(*) FROM death WHERE substr(death_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many observation utilization events in 2029 were followed by a readmission within 30 days?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='observation' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' AND readmitted_30d=1

questions.question: For appointments scheduled in 2029, how many were kept and how many were not kept? Use the outcome column and show each outcome with its count.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE substr(scheduled_date,1,4)='2029' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many distinct patients had any medication fill in 2029?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM fill WHERE substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029'
